text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day after training,
I was stopped by Eishin Flash.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: There is something I'd like to discuss.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You've seemed a bit absent-minded for the past five days.
Could it be that you're exhausted?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Indeed, my work had piled up, and I had been working overtime for a while.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I see. In that case, I have a proposal—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Would it be alright if I put together
our next training plan?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If we reduce the time spent formulating training plans,
it will give you more time to rest, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I was just thinking about fine-tuning
my self-training routine anyway,
so—"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I believe this proposal is a win-win,
so what do you say?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While I deeply appreciate it, this is originally
a Trainer's job. I wonder if it's really all right
to leave that much to them...
choice_data_list: Let's leave the next training session to them!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...!
Understood.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I will bring the plan I've prepared to the trainer's office tomorrow at 8:00 AM, then.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The booklet placed here contains
today's training plan.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Based on my current capabilities, I have determined that focusing on speed training here will lead to better growth.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The detailed schedule is as written.
How does it look to you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Although there were a few minor points of concern,
it was clear she had put careful thought into making it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Based on my current capabilities, I have determined that focusing on stamina training here will lead to better growth.

text_block_list.text:
The detailed schedule is as written.
How does it look to you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Although there were a few minor points of concern,
it was clear she had put careful thought into making it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If Trainer says so,
then I'm sure it'll be just fine.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Well then, I look forward to working
with you as usual next time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From this day on, Eishin Flash stopped
offering to create training plans
in particular.
